name: How long does a full kitchen renovation take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a full kitchen renovation take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full kitchen renovation typically takes four to eight weeks once on-site work begins, though custom cabinet orders and layout alterations can extend that timeframe. The process starts with demolition and custom framing adjustments if walls are being shifted. Next, mechanical trades handle rough-in plumbing and electrical updates for appliances and lighting. After inspections, drywall installation, taping, and texturing take place. The final phases involve tile or marble installation for backsplashes and floors, cabinet setting, trim carpentry, molding, and interior painting. Delays usually stem from material lead times or unexpected issues behind existing drywall, such as outdated wiring or plumbing lines that require corrective work before finish trades can begin.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most full kitchen renovations take between four and eight weeks of active construction, depending on cabinet delivery schedules and whether the room layout changes.
